tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash

Review the diff against this repo's golden rules and change guide. Report each violation with file:line and the rule it breaks; end with a verdict: ship, or the blocking items.

Read .claude/rules/golden-rules.md and .claude/rules/change-guide.md first. Run `node .claude/hooks/guardrail.mjs --scan` and include its findings. Write nothing.
